description: For a dynaset and a table-type recordset (Index PK_F) over F, and a snapshot and a forward-only recordset: read LastModified at open; AddNew, read LastModified; assign ID 20 and N 200, read; Update, read LastModified, Bookmark and ID; MoveFirst, read LastModified; Edit, Update, read; AddNew, CancelUpdate, read; Delete, read. Asks when LastModified is set (AddNew, assignment, Update), whether it survives moves, CancelUpdate and Delete, and which types answer. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
